fixes: Cloth is a flat smooth plane with a printed crest and nearly no drape or weave. Sheet-tex-cloth shows slubby linen with visible weave. Use the cloth albedo/normal at 0.4 m tiling, and add 2 to 3 soft vertical folds of 15 mm amplitude per metre.

Crest: small (about 0.35 of the width) and solid dark on cream. The lookbook shows a crest roundel centred higher, larger (60% of width), with the three steam wisps clearly separated. Enlarge to 0.6 w and use the sheet's wispy mountain with a ringed roundel.
Hanging: top rod and cords are barely visible, and the crimped tab loops are tiny. Use a 0.04 m dia. rod extending 0.08 m each side with turned end caps, and 3 visible tab loops 0.07 m wide.

Variation: three seeds mostly change colour. Add hem shape (swallowtail vs straight vs pointed, only seed 3 has it), a width spread of 0.6-1.2 m, and a different sway phase; also add a bottom weight bar at 0.02 m dia.
Dark scene: the cream banner reads flat brown in the canonical. Raise cream albedo to #E9DDC1 as intended and add a subtle translucent back-glow so it pops like the lookbook's lit banners.
LOD2/3: LOD2 crest is a bare triangle; keep a wispy-top triangle plus the rod at LOD2 and ensure the swallowtail is kept at LOD3.
library_issues: noren cloth reads smooth with no weave in renders; texture not visible at canonical distance.
cream looks tan/brown in low light; check albedo.
summary: Reads clearly as the tall crest banner and holds up as a swallowtail strip at LOD2 and LOD3. Construction is the weakest part: smooth flat cloth, a small crest and a thin rod. Seeds mainly swap colour, not shape.
